why: Neither includes a mustard velvet sofa and neither has a truly low bookshelf, but B delivers the lively, colorful boho mood the client asked for (red folk rug, tasseled print cushions, real palms, paper lantern). A is more polished but subdued, and its ceramic pots come with no plants. B's nursery pots and yellow cube shelf are easy swaps for ceramic planters and a low unit.
